title: OKIKE STUDIO
imageAlt: OKIKE Studio flagship platform and interactive client portal

introduction: Independent studio flagship, AI-assisted scoping funnel, and private client portal.
Connecting brand strategy, interactive engineering, and automated project operations.
caseStudy.coverAlt: OKIKE Studio flagship website and client workspace

facts.scope: Brand System, Web Flagship, Client Portal, AI Triage

question: Modern studios often split their marketing website, intake forms, and client delivery across disconnected third-party tools—creating friction before a project even begins.
Unify public positioning, interactive scoping, and live client project tracking into one fast, architectural web platform.
caseStudy.designDirection: Built on a stark monochrome and warm-paper palette punctuated by electric lime (#e3ed33), variable Bricolage Grotesque typography, and tactile 3D canvas interactions.
caseStudy.experience: Visitors explore transparent sprint pricing, consult a grounded Gemini AI assistant, submit structured briefs, and transition directly into a Supabase-backed client portal with live staging health checks.
outcome: Launched a full-lifecycle studio platform uniting marketing, CMS, AI scoping, and client deliverables.
Live flagship at https://studio.okikeenterprises.com/

title: UI OKIKE STUDIO
imageAlt: OKIKE Studio Figma design system and component architecture

caseStudy.metadataTitle: UI OKIKE Studio Figma System | OKIKE Studio
introduction: Complete Figma design system, responsive grid architecture, and interactive prototype.
The visual blueprint powering OKIKE Studio across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
caseStudy.previewNotice: FIGMA UI CASE STUDY · OKIKE STUDIO
caseStudy.coverAlt: OKIKE Studio Figma UI canvases and design tokens

facts.scope: UI/UX Design, Responsive Breakpoints, Interactive Prototype

question: Scaling a studio platform across marketing pages, multi-step enquiry flows, admin CMS views, and client dashboards requires strict visual consistency.
Establish a modular Figma component library and token system before writing a single line of production CSS.
caseStudy.designDirection: Swiss-inspired grid discipline, high-contrast surface hierarchy, and reusable auto-layout components calibrated for both light editorial pages and dark portal workspaces.
caseStudy.experience: Every screen—from hero compositions to mobile navigation drawers and pricing cards—was prototyped and stress-tested in Figma for rapid engineering handoff.
outcome: Delivered an end-to-end Figma master file with zero visual drift between design and Next.js implementation.
